description: Work out the FLSA overtime premium that counts as qualified overtime (Form W-2 box 12 code TT for 2026) and the employee deduction after the cap and income phaseout. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

capJoint.description: Annual overtime deduction cap, joint return (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 25000 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part III; 26 U.S.C. 225(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is joint; ignored otherwise.

capSingle.description: Annual overtime deduction cap (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 12500 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part III; 26 U.S.C. 225(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is single; ignored otherwise.

filing.description: Filing status for the deduction. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: single = Single, head of household or qualifying surviving spouse; joint = Married filing jointly; mfs = Married filing separately (deduction not allowed).

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) (US dollars). AGI plus any excluded foreign or territory income (sections 911, 931, 933).

otherQOC.description: Qualified overtime from other employers or weeks not listed (US dollars). Box 12 code TT amounts from other W-2s or other periods on the same return.

per1000.description: Reduction for each whole $1,000 over the threshold (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 100 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part III; 26 U.S.C. 225(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is single or joint; ignored otherwise.

thrJoint.description: MAGI phaseout threshold, joint return (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 300000 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part III; 26 U.S.C. 225(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is joint; ignored otherwise.

thrSingle.description: MAGI phaseout threshold (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 150000 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part III; 26 U.S.C. 225(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is single; ignored otherwise.

weeks.description: Workweeks with hours (one row per FLSA workweek). Use your own records for the same tax year.

bonus.description: Nondiscretionary bonus allocated to the week (US dollars). Production, attendance or other promised bonus, spread to the workweeks it covers.

hours.description: Hours worked in the workweek (hours). Total hours actually worked in the fixed 168-hour workweek.

otherPay.description: Shift differentials or commissions for the week (US dollars). Other straight-time pay for the week that belongs in the FLSA regular rate.

rate.description: Straight-time hourly rate (US dollars). The hourly rate paid for every hour, before any overtime premium.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.
